title: descurainia incisa var. viscosa
intro: Descurainia incisa var. viscosa, commonly known as sticky tansy or sticky whitlow-grass, is a plant species in the family Brassicaceae. It is used for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally employed to treat various health issues. The plant's health benefits include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The bioactive constituents of Descurainia incisa var. viscosa include sesquiterpenes, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
